label: Effective delivery through an interrupted borrower-only order and q44 source supply
summary: Compared the q44 distinct actual OwnBeing cause with a strengthened infinite borrower-only account in docs/notes/q44-inferential-dependency.md#can-effective-local-supply-continue-throughout-a-borrower-only-order. The earlier guarded state-indexed tail leaves multiple populated suffixes possible. Strengthening its law to effective delivery at an intact link gives an exact arbitrary-interruption criterion. Population is possible iff some upstream suffix is intact. In any populated solution, x is active iff every link at or above x is intact. Each such x has an actual distinct neighbour under the existing tailAtState profile. All surviving local responses are compatible with the explicit interpretation OwnBeing nowhere, so the q44 conclusion is not forced by selection and transmission. Unbounded interruptions eliminate the populated solution, whereas a separately posited active input can sustain an isolated lower segment. The difference is independence of that channel, not existential independence. Proof and exact reproduction command are linked in the note (Scratch/q44-borrowed-supply/InterruptedTransmission.lean, local Lean check, unregistered). This is an analyst's structural intervention model, not a counterexample to real productive existential borrowing or a defeat of supplier completeness. The cut-surviving input could borrow its actuality elsewhere. The conditional case for a nonborrowed giver rests on the received-as-produced demand for an account of the order’s productive exercise and on the proposal that an intrinsically actual giver exercises its power toward these recipients. The primitive populated-order rival explains its member responses and survives. Existing q44 composition, reception, ancestry and source-selection obligations remain. That single-chain investigation added no registered entailment, source attribution or formal premise change. Follow-up on 20babef7: the finite supplier-audit model proves that every finite selection of complete incoming lists with the endless record permits both root verdicts, even for a chosen predecessor cone. A finite closed roster with strict rank in every compatible assignment suffices for de dicto knowledge. See docs/notes/de-ente-esse-source-1628.md#supplier-completeness-under-extension-of-an-audited-order for the de re boundary and the remaining actual-esse applicability question. The registered parallel-chain classification subsumes the single-chain transmission lemmas. One on/off choice per chain with an intact tail describes every solution. The diagonal argument shows why a countable catalogue cannot cover every allowed assignment on countably many independent intact chains. See docs/notes/causal-finitism-367.md#how-many-choices-does-a-chain-of-borrowers-require. The original activity classification and diagonal comparison were accepted with qualifications at 505fedc6cd01b43f0cd7ccb4a7430cda6afe050a. The single-cut comparison now tests a fixed receiving endpoint. Rebuilding the relays, isolating a named feed, and counting fresh copies distinguished a stopping point on the tested route from intrinsic sourcehood and distinguished information about the nearest feed from information about additional feeds. Lane E, #2103, PR #2113 semantic repair: the parallel-ray report result 6da2cd1a remains unplaced. RayReportCharacterization decides feasibility of an activity report, including all-off. The existing mixed-live result rules out a single common Boolean setting when two verified live observations disagree. That is a test of a report law, compatible with one productive source delivering through paths with different response rules. No matched root-route premise requires that report law. The prior plan required proving the target's esse-causal and OwnBeing clauses independently, and omitted distinctness. The ray result contributes none of those facts. Reopen on independent identification of live paths, recipient and distinct supplier, and on a test that separates the supplier's own subsistent esse from activity received through an unobserved channel in the same interpretation.
blocker: Investigate what grounds the actual exercise in a particular supplier-complete esse cone at matching scope: a giver whose intrinsic actuality suffices for giving to this recipient, or a concrete governing whole that realizes its members' exercise. An active input that survives a channel cut is only relatively independent. Local interventions do not establish collective rootedness, OwnBeing, common selection or that the existential relation has this transmission semantics.

current_assessment.scope: How many independent choices does one infinite chain of borrowers need? When does agreement between borrowers favor a common setting? What do primary and auxiliary cuts reveal about the feeds to one fixed receiver?
current_assessment.assessment: One intact infinite chain has exactly two states. The state of one receiver fixes the state of every bearer on that chain. Observing activity fixes the choice on that chain alone. Each other uncoupled chain with an intact upstream tail adds one independent choice. Even with countably many chains the uniform active state has a short description, although any countable catalogue misses some admissible assignment. A finite ontology can have a headcount advantage at matched adequacy. Explaining this receiver’s actual power requires an account of why the selected state obtains, whether through a concrete law or whole whose obtaining accounts for that activity, or a source that actually supplies it. A verified cut at or above a maintained feed preserves the receiver’s activity in the stipulated single-ray model. Every tested cut can extinguish it if a feed lies deeper. Under a proper law over cut positions, sensitivity at depth d is the mass at or beyond d and tends to zero. Conditional on a known cut below d, both accounts predict failure. The first surviving cut locates the nearest maintained feed. One feed there and a maintained feed at every deeper stage have the same Boolean record for all cuts. Counting maintained positions as independent posits favors one over infinitely many at that observational scope. If each feed contributes one separately counted unit, adjacent counts distinguish additional feeds. In seven byte relays the external feed replaced the successor input at the fed stage. One and two writers agreed on which cuts yielded any fresh token, but yielded different counts. A second active chain can itself supply the identified feed and sustain every selected primary response with no intrinsic token. With the primary input at the feed depth already cut, isolating the auxiliary entrance separates the intrinsic and borrowed tokens under their complete supply laws. On any finite panel the complete space of feasible reports has one binary choice per distinct observed ray with an intact tail. One live reading on and another off exclude the shared switch. A shared setting on separate immediate suppliers fits unanimous live readings. At equal one-half marginals, three preselected distinct live rays all reporting on give a likelihood ratio of four for shared against independent settings. Repeating one ray gives a ratio of one. This favors a shared random setting over the calibrated independent alternative. Distinct productive suppliers whose settings share the same random value with the same law give identical observational predictions. Identifying one productive cause requires additional causal evidence. Application to the same recipients’ existence requires an identified productive relation and grounds for the rival predictions.
current_assessment.next_test: Trace whether a change in the candidate giver’s actual contribution reaches both recipients along identified live paths while their common operating condition stays fixed. A break in one path can explain a mixed report even with one controller. Reuse the existing feed-cut controls for alternative inputs and the receiver’s own reserves. Applying the result to an ultimate giver still requires that the paths supply existence and that their candidate source is underived. For the proposed giver of this particular recipient’s existence, establish what covers all inputs to that giver’s own act. The internal-reception argument bears on that question if its essence is its act of existence and being caused entails reception in a principle. Test the latter claim in the same simple created bearer on which the Thomist and Suárez agree about the external giving and finite effect. A difference in an operational feed’s transmission already has the narrower relay explanation.
